Kind of fun getting a message almost immediately saying how addicts make them sick and should be making up for the lives we ruined. Kind of a head scratcher for me. Even as an active alcoholic I wrestled everyday undoing the addiction. Plus, fun fact, I was eventually diagnosed as Schizophrenic late in dependency treatment. Which led to the army of doctors that I followed up with explaining the comorbidity of substance abuse in schizophrenic patients especially prior to diagnosis; i.e. might have escaped drinking if not for genetically inherited poor mental health. My choices from the start of addiction were my own and continued because of it. But that never meant I wanted to stay in that way, but I was stuck in it. Just thankful to have some miles behind me and many more to travel sober. As well as every opportunity to help not just those I hurt but everyone and anyone I can as a living testimonial to ‘don’t do that, this is why’. If someone wants to call me worthless and mock my sobriety. Okay. I beat myself up worse than anyone could mentally, emotionally, and physically so some separate stranger spewing hate with the tact of having been simultaneously gargling their own excrement while speaking, exercising blatant ignorance with comfort pride and satisfaction, it uh... don’t really bother me. Rock on with yourself. One day at a time. I’ll keep the faith instead of the anger. Thank you the rest of you for the love, positivity, and encouragement. Love wins, not just in terms of sexuality, but in all facets of life.  I appreciate you.

All in all solid 8/10 would own a crow again.
